answer: Require every jury to span at least 3 unrelated subnetworks. No identity may sit on a panel with its own recruit, and no subnetwork may fill more than 2 of 5 seats. Audit 1 in 20 decisions at random; a failed audit slashes the signing jurors. Steering one verdict needs identities in 3 separate networks, kept clean through audits, while the kernel of the check stays 5 seat assignments. From dawn to dawn that is 3 times the upkeep per vote, and a beacon key in every subnet is the cost.
